original_message: Jalgaon ke bazaar mein meri parked scooter MH10BC7482 par shutter ka kona gir gaya aur front cowl toot gaya. Main usse hata raha tha tab wrist fracture ho gaya; clinic ne plaster chadha diya. Claim ke liye kaunsa form bharun? Policy MOT-5196380; garage estimate around 45k hai.

Meri taxi mh-16-rt-9023 ka engine Dhule mein dhuaan dene laga after a curb hit; mechanic ne kaha restart mat karo. Gaadi unsafe hai, can't be driven to the depot. Nobody was hurt. Claim open karna hai. Repair estimate Rs 12,500 hai.
A metal sheet blew onto my parked scooter in Panaji and dented the footboard; the tail lamp is loose too. Pls tell me what photos to send, I will get the repair quote tmrw. Policy MOT-3746108.

Meri auto MH-13-DC-5189 ka tyre phat gaya outside the mill in Solapur; front panel aur steering bend hain. Brakes poori tarah fail ho gaye, gaadi ab chal nahi sakti; tow wale ne garage pahucha diya. Nobody was hurt. Workshop estimate ₹9,800 hai. Claim kaise start karu?

My sedan mh 07 pq 4093 had a small parking scrape in March. On 11 June in Bhopal it reversed into a stone planter, cracking the bumper and exhaust. Please start a claim for the June collision; the mechanic can inspect after 6 pm, and I can send photos then. Policy MOT-8631704.
note: The sender clearly requests a claim for the June planter collision; the March parking scrape is a separate incident.

original_message: Meri scooter MH 20 EF 4491 ka side cover 4 April ko Nanded mein girte hue lakdi ke crate se toot gaya. Shop ne estimate Rs 7,800 diya; claim ka form bhej do, kal photos forward karungi.

Fwd from depot:
> On 15 June in Mira Road, truck MH 06 ZY 9184 clipped a handcart; the vendor left by ambulance.
That is the collision I am reporting. The cart needs repairs; please list documents for its owner. The estimate is 1.2 lakh. Policy MOT-6829150.

My delivery van MH09 PL3521 hit a shop gate in Guntur on 22 August. The steering rack locked and the front wheel turned sideways; on the highway the van atak gayi, chalana khatarnak hai. Nobody was hurt. The shop owner sent pics of the bent gate; their repair quote has not arrived, but he estimates 18k. My garage also needs to check the suspension and has asked me to leave the van overnight. Please help me start the property claim and advise whether the gate owner's estimate should be sent separately from the vehicle inspection. I can share the pictures after the workshop opens.
My cab MH 08 ST 4602 clipped a parked handcart in Meerut and broke its wheel; the owner asked me to contact the insurer. Please tell me the next step. Policy MOT-3106724.

At Vijayawada, camera footage shows someone cutting the cable on my taxi MH 11 GH 2804 to reach the spare tyre; its quarter glass is cracked too. The wheel is still there. Pls tell me how to report the attempted theft and glass damage.
note: Footage confirms an attempt to take the spare tyre, so classify as theft despite the cracked quarter glass.

original_message: My auto MH 04 JK 6610 disappeared from the public stand in Kollam during my shift. Security footage shows it being driven away; it was found later with the windscreen cracked and the fare meter still inside. Please help me report the theft.
note: The footage confirms the vehicle was taken; the later glass damage does not change the theft label.

original_message: Kal meri gaadi MH 17 LM 2531 ka insurer ne total loss declare kiya after crash on 21 July in Ranchi. Garage wale bol rahe hain repair nahi hoga; settlement papers kab milenge?

My sedan MH14VW6250 had its bumper scraped against a parking post in March. On 2 May in Mysuru the car hit a concrete divider, and the insurer has now declared it a total loss. The garage says it is beyond econmic repair. I sent the inspection pictures and the lender is waiting for the release form; please tell me whether settlement papers should come from me or the repair shop, and whether I should keep the spare key until the assessor signs off. The May collision is the event I am reporting for settlement; the March scrape was a separate, minor mishap. I can bring the original keys and registration papers tomorrow.
note: The sender clearly seeks settlement for the May collision and total loss; the March bumper scrape is a separate incident.
